issues.description: Basic usage example uses awkward next(n for n in pipeline.nodes) instead of indexing
issues.detail: The snippet `training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is unnecessarily indirect for getting the first (only) node. `pipeline.nodes[0]` is clearer and idiomatic. Since this is the first example users copy, the idiom they learn here propagates. Replace with direct indexing or filter by name.

issues.description: Image preview example has unreachable code after return
issues.detail: In the Image preview section, the commented-out `return ImagePreview(...)` for data URI sits after a live `return` statement. As written even uncommented it would be dead code. Restructure as two separate functions or an if/else so the example is actually runnable and instructive, rather than syntactically misleading.

issues.description: preview_from_dataframe example has signature inconsistent with preview_fn contract
issues.detail: Earlier docs state preview functions take no node inputs ('Preview functions don't have access to node inputs or outputs directly'), yet `preview_from_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame)` and `preview_from_polars(df)` accept a df arg. Without context, readers will wire this as `preview_fn=preview_from_dataframe` and get a TypeError. Show via closure or note the example is illustrative-only.

issues.description: Trailing-node example in pipeline snippets omits required Pipeline wrapping
issues.detail: Several later examples (Mermaid customization, Text preview) show a bare `node(...)` call at module level without wrapping in a `Pipeline([...])`. New users copying these will get an orphan Node. Either show them inside a Pipeline like the first example or annotate them as 'node definition fragment'.

issues.description: Polars added to ignore.txt with both capitalizations is redundant if matcher is case-insensitive
issues.detail: `Polars` already exists on line 68; adding lowercase `polars` directly below suggests the Vale matcher is case-sensitive here. Worth a quick check — if the rule is case-insensitive, this entry is noise; if it is sensitive, fine. Minor either way.

issues.description: PR checklist notes 'Added tests to cover my changes' is unchecked and no RELEASE.md entry
issues.detail: Docs-only PR may legitimately skip tests, but the PR description leaves the RELEASE.md checkbox unchecked. Since this documents a new public API surface (`preview_fn`, `preview_contract`), a RELEASE.md entry under docs or features would help users discover the capability. Add a short bullet.

review.summary: Documentation-only PR adding a fairly thorough guide to node preview functions, plus minor Vale style config tweaks. The content is structured well and covers each preview type, but several code examples are misleading or non-runnable: an unreachable `return` in the Image preview, preview functions that take arguments contradicting the stated contract, and bare `node(...)` calls outside a Pipeline. No correctness or security issues; main risk is users copying the snippets verbatim and hitting confusing errors. A RELEASE.md entry would also help discoverability.
